picks.title: The cross: on the bottom, then short
picks.reason: Cross is furthest from your goal

history.content: What does the apostrophe mean in R'?
{"answer":"It means turn that face a quarter turn anticlockwise, as you look at it.","refs":[],"followUps":[]}
How do I stop dropping the cube?
{"answer":"Hold it lightly and keep your thumbs on the sides. A slightly looser grip usually feels more secure.","refs":[],"followUps":[]}
{"answer":"A modern magnetic cube helps, but any smooth one is fine for now.","refs":[],"followUps":[]}
How many solves should I do a day?
{"answer":"Ten to twenty good ones. Slow down on the bad ones and work out why they were bad.","refs":[],"followUps":[]}
{"answer":"Time most of them, but don't chase the number. Look at the average, not single solves.","refs":[],"followUps":[]}
{"answer":"An average of 12: drop the best and worst, average the other ten.","refs":[],"followUps":[]}
Do I need to learn to look ahead?
{"answer":"Later. Right now smooth, accurate solving matters more than formal lookahead drills.","refs":[],"followUps":[]}
